description: This file contains the implementation of a test adapter factory for an Orleans stream provider, specifically a version used for monitoring and testing. It includes classes for creating and managing cache factories, monitors, and command execution related to EventHub stream processing within Orleans.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderForMonitorTestsAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating test stream providers with monitoring capabilities, extending EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory.

classes.name: CacheFactoryForMonitorTesting
classes.description: A specialized cache factory used for monitoring during tests, extending EventHubQueueCacheFactory.

classes.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor
classes.description: A mock implementation of ICachePressureMonitor for testing cache pressure scenarios.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of EHStreamProviderForMonitorTestsAdapterFactory configured with dependencies from IServiceProvider.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the adapter factory, setting the receiver monitor factory and cache pressure injection monitor.

methods.name: ChangeCachePressure
methods.description: Toggles the pressure status on cachePressureInjectionMonitor.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory configured for testing, incorporating monitoring components.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes various commands such as retrieving monitor counters or changing cache pressure state based on command id.
